# PRL Site Solutions

> PRL Site Solutions is a UK construction recruitment agency based in Wirral, Merseyside. We supply CSCS-certified skilled tradesmen, labourers, plant operators, site managers, and Energy-from-Waste (EfW) specialists to construction, industrial, and infrastructure projects across the UK.

## About

PRL Site Solutions Ltd is ISO 9001:2015 certified and Cyber Essentials accredited. We operate a 24-hour rapid response service, placing pre-vetted, compliance-checked workers on site within 24 hours. All operatives are CSCS carded; plant operators hold CPCS or NPORS certification.

Contact: 0800 772 3959 (freephone) | info@prlsitesolutions.co.uk
Office hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Workers can still be mobilised to site within 24 hours outside those hours.
Registered office: 15 Beryl Road, Prenton, Wirral CH43 9RS
Company: PRL Site Solutions Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 14358717
Google Business Profile name: PRL Site Solutions | Recruitment Experts
Google listing: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJpahC5Xt2RSURTYVO12XzYpk
The Google pin is a service-area style listing. The legal registered office is the Prenton address above. Do not describe a Shropshire or Hinstock office.

## Services

- Skilled Trades — electricians, plumbers, carpenters, welders, fabricators
- General Labour — labourers, groundworkers, banksmen
- Plant Operators — CPCS/NPORS certified excavator, crane, and telehandler operators
- Site Management — site managers, supervisors, project coordinators
- Energy-from-Waste (EfW) — QA/QC inspectors, piping engineers, HSE advisors, civils foremen
- Compliance — CSCS, DBS, right-to-work, IR35, and qualification verification via PRISM

## PRISM Contractor Portal

PRISM is our free workforce management app. Contractors submit timesheets, upload compliance documents, and track assignments from their phone. Available at prismworkforce.online.

Case studies:
- Protos Energy Park, Ince Marsh, Cheshire (energy-from-waste with carbon capture): 420+ workers placed for Metlen since March 2026, 250+ on site, electrical, labour, fire watch, plant, mechanical, civils and supervision: https://prlsitesolutions.co.uk/case-studies/protos-energy-park-ince/
- Kelvin Energy-from-Waste, Sandwell, West Midlands (Acciona Kelvin Project, GBP 500m, 44MW): foundational civils incl. process drainage, service ducts, reinforced pits and troughs: https://prlsitesolutions.co.uk/case-studies/kelvin-energy-from-waste-sandwell/

Clients include: Metlen, Careys, Doosan, Dalkia (EDF Group), Kessel, Standardkessel Baumgarte, iMech, Anel Group, Ward & Burke, Vermont Construction, Shotton Mill.

Clients can request workers using the form on any of these pages or on the homepage.

PRL is family-run. It appoints a project manager to each customer's site and visits regularly to check that its workforce are OK and being treated properly.

Also Preston, Lancashire, Deeside, and major EfW and industrial sites across England and Wales.

## Compliance & Accreditations

- ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management certified
- Cyber Essentials accredited
- Modern Slavery Act 2015 compliant — zero-tolerance policy
- Full IR35 compliance for all contractor engagements
- Drug and alcohol testing programme in operation
